install_lightplane_package: run setup.py to install the lightplane package with triton, cogapp, configargparse, and tqdm dependencies
review_setup_configuration: review the setup.py configuration for the lightplane package including version, dependencies, and excluded packages
summarize_package_dependencies: summarize the lightplane package dependencies including triton 2.1.0, cogapp, configargparse, and tqdm
